args.title: Bellwether Freight Pricing – Combined Summary
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece: shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.

Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/freight ; https://insights.bellwether.example/freight/companion (unregistered view, may be partial)
